notes: Development-only explicit federated-summary experiment. Clients retain z_i, C_i and raw trajectories. Each stochastic EM round broadcasts group parameters; participating clients compute responsibilities and contribute only additive precision, mean, scatter, mass and likelihood statistics. The final control-aware manifold is constructed from additive group moments. Secure aggregation is emulated at the interface, not cryptographically implemented. Fed100 must reproduce an all-client implementation of the same update rule. Centralized refers to the established 9H individual-summary implementation. Progressive ranks are frozen from 9H.
